chapterInfo.content:
46
Babel abosom ahweaseɛ
1 # Yer 50.2 Bel#46.1 BEL: Yei yɛ Babel anyame atitire no mu baako. butu, Nebo#46.1 NEBO: Yei ne Bepɔ Nebo a saa berɛ no mu na abɛyɛ deɛ ebinom som. koto;
akwantuo mmoa ne anantwie soso wɔn ahoni;
wɔakyekyere mo nnesoa
asoasoa mmoa a wɔrebrɛ.
2Wɔbom koto butu;
wɔntumi nnsi amanehunu ano;
na wɔn ara nso kɔ atukorɔ mu.
3Yakob fie ne Israel fie nkaeɛ nyinaa,
mo a wɔaturu mo afiri yafunu mu
na masoa mo afiri awotwaa mu no,
monyɛ aso mma me.
4 # Dwom 71.18 Na ɛkɔsi w’akwakorabɔ mu, mene me ara,
na ɛkɔsi ɛdwonofuo mu mpo, mede wo bɛsi akɔnkɔn;
me na mayɛ, na me na mɛsoa,
me na mede wo bɛsi akɔnkɔn, na magye wo.
5 # Yes 44.9-20 Hwan na mode me bɛto ne ho na ɔne me ayɛ pɛ,
na mode no bɛsusu me, na yɛasɛ?
6Wɔn deɛ, wɔhwie sika firi fotoɔ mu,
na wɔde nsania kari dwetɛ;
wɔbɔ sikadwumfoɔ paa na ɔnyɛ no onyame;
wɔkoto, na wɔsɔre no.
7Wɔma no so si akɔnkɔn
kɔsoɛ no si ne sibea, na ɛsi hɔ;
ɛntwe ne ho mfiri n’afa;
wɔteam frɛ no a, ɔmmua,
na ɔntumi nnye obi, n’ahohia mu.
Nkwagyeɛ no abɛn
8Monkae yei, na monnwene ho,
mo mmaratofoɔ, mokae ɛ.
9 # Yes 44.6 Monkae akane nnoɔma a ɛfiri tete no,
sɛ me ara mene Onyankopɔn, na obiara nni hɔ bio;
mene Onyankopɔn, na deɛ ɔte sɛ me nni hɔ koraa.
10 # Yes 42.9 Me a mefiri mfitiaseɛ meka awieeɛ asɛm,
na mefiri tete mmerɛ no meka deɛ wɔnyɛeɛ no,
meka sɛ: Me tirimbɔ bɛgyina,
na deɛ ɛsɔ m’ani nyinaa mɛyɛ.
11 # Yes 41.2 Mɛfrɛ ɔkoropɔn bi afiri apueeɛ
ne m’agyina mu barima afiri akyirikyiri asase so.
Makasa, na mɛma no aba mu;
madwene, na mɛyɛ.
12Montie me, asobrakyefoɔ
a mo ne tenenee ntam twe.
13Mede me tenenee apinkyɛ, ɛnni akyiri,
na me nkwagyeɛ renka akyi.
Mede nkwagyeɛ bɛsi Sion,
na mede m’animuonyam mama Israel.

pageProps.chapterText:
Bel butu, Nebo koto;
akwantuo mmoa ne anantwie soso wɔn ahoni;
wɔakyekyere mo nnesoa
asoasoa mmoa a wɔrebrɛ.
Wɔbom koto butu;
wɔntumi nnsi amanehunu ano;
na wɔn ara nso kɔ atukorɔ mu.

Yakob fie ne Israel fie nkaeɛ nyinaa,
mo a wɔaturu mo afiri yafunu mu
na masoa mo afiri awotwaa mu no,
monyɛ aso mma me.
Na ɛkɔsi w’akwakorabɔ mu, mene me ara,
na ɛkɔsi ɛdwonofuo mu mpo, mede wo bɛsi akɔnkɔn;
me na mayɛ, na me na mɛsoa,
me na mede wo bɛsi akɔnkɔn, na magye wo.

Hwan na mode me bɛto ne ho na ɔne me ayɛ pɛ,
na mode no bɛsusu me, na yɛasɛ?
Wɔn deɛ, wɔhwie sika firi fotoɔ mu,
na wɔde nsania kari dwetɛ;
wɔbɔ sikadwumfoɔ paa na ɔnyɛ no onyame;
wɔkoto, na wɔsɔre no.
Wɔma no so si akɔnkɔn
kɔsoɛ no si ne sibea, na ɛsi hɔ;
ɛntwe ne ho mfiri n’afa;
wɔteam frɛ no a, ɔmmua,
na ɔntumi nnye obi, n’ahohia mu.


Monkae yei, na monnwene ho,
mo mmaratofoɔ, mokae ɛ.
Monkae akane nnoɔma a ɛfiri tete no,
sɛ me ara mene Onyankopɔn, na obiara nni hɔ bio;
mene Onyankopɔn, na deɛ ɔte sɛ me nni hɔ koraa.
Me a mefiri mfitiaseɛ meka awieeɛ asɛm,
na mefiri tete mmerɛ no meka deɛ wɔnyɛeɛ no,
meka sɛ: Me tirimbɔ bɛgyina,
na deɛ ɛsɔ m’ani nyinaa mɛyɛ.
Mɛfrɛ ɔkoropɔn bi afiri apueeɛ
ne m’agyina mu barima afiri akyirikyiri asase so.
Makasa, na mɛma no aba mu;
madwene, na mɛyɛ.

Montie me, asobrakyefoɔ
a mo ne tenenee ntam twe.
Mede me tenenee apinkyɛ, ɛnni akyiri,
na me nkwagyeɛ renka akyi.
Mede nkwagyeɛ bɛsi Sion,
na mede m’animuonyam mama Israel.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
